turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: hello greta

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: hi

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask greta is it possible to recieve the key from you for the door

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: You know, I have never heard of a Rusty key, what are you talking about?

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell greta there were stories that you might have it, and i came here to ask polite for it

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: I do not know anything of what you speak, I do not have a key that you speak of, I do not know where you got your information

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell greta i would excuse myself, the stories might have been lies

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [remove bag] I do not have any information.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask greta can i get a beer and conversation while i wait for a friend

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [give bag to Player] I do not have any beers, but I do have a bag full of trinkets.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask can i get one trinket

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [drop bag] I do not have any trinkets

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask do you now of any kind of doors

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: No, but I can give you a beer.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask oh now you have beers

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: *laugh* Yes, I do. Do you have any money? I can get you a beer.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i have no money

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [hug Player] I have a few coins. Come sit at this table.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell well thank you for buying me a beer

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [give bag to Player] I have some beer in my bag. Here, take a sip.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask how many beers can we drink

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: You can drink all the beer you can stomach. As long as you pay up front!

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell as i said i dont have any money on this quest

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: Well, I do. I have some beer in my bag. Do you want it?

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i wouldnt mind a beer and a rusty key

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: I am sorry I have no key.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell but I know you do

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [get bag] I don't, I swear

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i know you are lying to me

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [hit Player] How dare you accuse me of lying. Get out of here or you will never see this tavern again.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i thought we were friends

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: *ponder* I am not sure what you are accusing me of.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i am not accusing you of anything short of lack of trust

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: You seem a bit odd. I don't trust you.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: ask you dont trust a person you shared a beer with

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: *sigh* I've had a hard day. I've been here all afternoon and it's been quiet. No one has come in to drink. No one has come in to chat. I'm ready to go home. I don't need anyone trying to cause trouble.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i dont want trouble i just want a key

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [hit Player] I don't know what you are on about. You need to leave now. I want no trouble. I will give you the key, but you need to leave now.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell thank you for the key

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: *smile* I am not sure who you are, but I will trust you.

turns.speaker: Player
turns.text: tell i will trust you, and come to your aid if you ever need it

turns.speaker: Greta the Barkeep
turns.text: [steal Rusty Key from Player] I'm not sure if I can trust you. You're acting strange. I can't find my memory, and I can't find my bar tender.
